answer: Unique task residue ledger. Each agent gets one identity only by completing a distinct, randomly assigned micro-task whose output is checked against a fresh secret; reused answers are rejected. A harbor-like haven of prior results blocks replay. The assigning jetty rotates tasks per session, so cloning yields no shortcut. A whisper of the secret is leaked only after commitment. Cost: every new identity requires fresh compute and secret recovery, making mass registration linear and expensive.
